justification: Inspected byte-buddy-maven-plugin/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/build/maven/ByteBuddyMojo.java: the nested Coordinate class is a tiny 2-field value object with only a constructor, hashCode, and equals (lines 1240-1282). Repository search showed all references are inside the same ByteBuddyMojo.java file only: it is used as a Map key and in lookups/parameter types (e.g. lines 266-269, 329, 341, 359, 403, 1162-1164), with no other source files referencing this nested class. That gives it low fan-out and no meaningful external fan-in, so it does not exhibit hub-like modularization.
